history_model: one existing durable fact plus one user-provided correction per isolated trial
agent_write_phase: read exact active fact; inline extract one correction; use returned persisted statement and source quote for pre-invalidation verification when supported; otherwise reread the returned episode; invalidate only the exact stale fact
recall_phase: fresh agent session reads only the corrected memory
independent_probe: fixed query on the same trial store after both agent sessions
agent_managed_claim_scope: bounded correction workflow feasibility and tool/token cost; not broad population benefit or long-term maintenance
